notes: KMEA runs three all-state choral ensembles (High School Treble and Mixed Choirs, Middle Level Choir, Elementary Choir), all performing at the KMEA In-Service Workshop at Century II in Wichita in February 2027. The Kansas Choral Directors Association (KCDA) separately runs a Treble Honor Choir that shares the middle-level concert; KMEA warns that a student who auditions for both the KCDA Treble Choir and the KMEA Middle Level Choir will be disqualified. All dates and fees recorded here are explicitly labeled 2026-27 on KMEA's pages. The high school repertoire page carried a 'Please standby for updates' caveat at retrieval, so the listed titles may still change.

organization.name: Kansas Music Educators Association
organization.description: KMEA is the federated Kansas state association of NAfME. It administers the All-State ensembles, whose audition process begins at the student's own school, progresses through the KMEA District Organization, and culminates in selection to the All-State ensembles that perform at KMEA's annual In-Service Workshop.

programs.name: KMEA All-State Mixed Choir
programs.description: 256-voice All-State Mixed Choir. The Mixed and Treble Choirs are both selected from a single audition; treble voices are alternatingly assigned to the Treble and Mixed Choirs, and assignments are not announced until the state rosters are posted. Both choirs share a combined concert (one ticket admits to both). HS Mixed Choir Chair: Brandon Wade, Pratt HS.

dates.title: Regular audition registration deadline
dates.description: 11:59:59 PM CT on Sunday, October 11, 2026. Online entries can be made after that point at higher audition fees; fee levels are set by KMEA district and based on entry time-stamps. One registration covers both district and state consideration.

dates.title: KMEA All-State Choirs concert
dates.description: Saturday, Feb. 27, 2027, Century II Convention Hall, Wichita. Concert times TBA; clinicians TBA. Combined concert with the All-State Treble Choir.

requirements.title: Sponsoring teacher must be a KMEA member
requirements.description: For a student to participate in a KMEA All-State ensemble, the sponsoring teacher must be a member of KMEA. For all registration entries, the sponsoring director must be a KMEA member.

requirements.title: Multi-stage audition beginning at the district level
requirements.description: The audition process begins at the student's own school and progresses through the KMEA District Organization. Students with the top audition scores at the district level are then eligible for selection to the All-State Choirs.

requirements.title: Published copies of music required
requirements.description: Every student singing in the District or All-State Choirs will have published copies of each piece of music.

requirements.title: Prepare all performance selections after roster posting
requirements.description: Following posting of the state rosters, students are to prepare all pieces listed under Performance Selections.

fees.description: A Participation Fee of $75 is assessed to the school of each student selected to sing in the All-State Choirs. Invoices are posted in the KMEA Members portal. The fee is required for each student named to the roster; students who withdraw still incur it; alternates added to the roster are charged the regular fee; schools with an outstanding balance from the previous year may not register students. Exceptions must be approved by the KMEA Executive Council.

programs.description: KMEA's middle-level all-state choir, selected by blind judging of uploaded mp3 auditions through the Festival Scores system. Middle Level Choir Chair: Lance Burnett, Chanute MS. Shares a combined concert with the KCDA Treble Honor Choir.

dates.title: Audition fees due
dates.description: Oct. 26, 2026 — audition fees due, $12 per student. Blind judging of submissions is also completed by this date.

dates.description: Auditions unpaid by this date will be disqualified.

dates.title: Website notification of accepted singers
dates.description: Directors submit the $65-per-student Participation Fee, immediately due upon notification of acceptance.

dates.description: Friday, Feb. 26, 2027, Century II Concert Hall, Wichita. Concert times TBA; clinicians TBA.

requirements.title: Sponsoring teacher must be a KMEA member
requirements.description: For a student to participate in a KMEA All-State ensemble, the sponsoring teacher must be a member of KMEA.

requirements.title: mp3 audition uploaded via Festival Scores
requirements.description: Teachers register students, create student profiles in Festival Scores (height and shirt size required for each student), and upload the mp3 audition recordings. A KMEA-published event tag activates the audition event in the director's account; the 2026-27 tag was to be published ahead of the Sep. 1 opening.

requirements.title: Blind judging against an established rubric
requirements.description: Judges log in, listen to auditions as many times as needed, score them using the established rubric, and identify disqualifying factors. Judges do not know who they are listening to and have no access to identifying information. The Middle Level Choir Chair verifies judging, validates disqualifying factors, and generates the final roster.

requirements.title: May not audition for both KCDA Treble Choir and KMEA Middle Level Choir
requirements.description: Auditions submitted to BOTH the KCDA Treble Choir and the KMEA Middle Level Choir will be disqualified. Students must select, with assistance from their teacher, only one choir for which they will audition.

fees.description: $65 per selected student, immediately due upon notification of acceptance.
